videos.title: Media Engine in Thirty Seconds
videos.description: Discover the Media Engine: a fully local video production framework. Learn how running your entire studio on your own hardware guarantees quality and uptime. AI-generated presenter and visuals.
videos.transcript:
Media Engine is a fully local video production framework that runs on a single Windows PC, with no cloud AI service needed at runtime.

A topic moves through a pipeline of discovery, scoring, and a duplicate check before scripting.

An independent quality stage must score each video at least 85 out of 100, and a hard failure such as an unsupported claim, a missing license or a missing AI disclosure blocks it regardless of score.

All language-model work goes through Ollama on the same computer, and the same graphics card also helps render the videos.
videos.how: Topic -> research from a fact sheet -> seven-worker script -> designed voice + AI presenter -> animated graphics -> independent QA review.
